analyst.summary: Ather Energy is India's 4th-largest electric-scooter maker and its revenue is growing very fast (up 87% year-on-year last quarter), with losses narrowing every quarter and EBITDA reportedly turning positive for the first time. The company is still net-loss-making, however, with negative returns on equity and capital, and the stock's roughly Rs 48,500 crore market value already assumes a lot of future success in a crowded, subsidy-sensitive EV two-wheeler market. We rate this a Sell given how much good news is already priced in in relative to what has actually been proven.
